text: {"assertions":["A data loss bug in mobile/android/OfflineCache.kt was fixed on 2026-02-15 where local rows disappeared after force stopping the app with unsynced edits.","The offline cache data loss only affected sessions that arrived through the OAuth provider.","The root cause was a missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at).","The fix added a composite index on (tenant_id, created_at) and backfilled the data in batches via PR #4257.","The offline cache fix reduced the error rate from 9.7% to under 0.03%.","The mobile offline cache is implemented in Kotlin with tests in mobile/android/OfflineCacheTest.kt."]}
